name: Dynamic Island
author: buildscript-dev
description: An iPhone-style Dynamic Island for Omarchy: a floating bubble in the bar that springs open for music, volume and brightness, notifications, charging, Bluetooth, timers and screen recording, with a built-in Control Center for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, earbuds, tray and power.

barWidget.description: iPhone-style floating island with live activities. Reserves its space in the bar.

schema.label: Island shape
schema.description: pill: floating iPhone-style bubble inside the bar. notch: MacBook notch hanging from the top edge.

schema.label: Bubble width when idle (px, pill shape)
Gap between the bubble and the top edge (px)
Island surface
schema.description: black: true MacBook notch. bar: the bar's own theme color. glass: translucent and blurred.

schema.label: Accent colors
schema.description: apple: Apple system colors (green charging, orange timer…). theme: the Omarchy theme's accent and urgent colors.

schema.label: Notch width (px, notch shape)
Open when the pointer rests on the notch
Hover delay before opening (ms)
Peek new notifications in the island
Show volume / brightness / keyboard OSD in the island
schema.description: Takes over `omarchy osd`. Keep omarchy.osd in disabledPlugins while this is on.

schema.label: Tuck the notch away over fullscreen windows
Keep the island visible when nothing is happening (off = auto-hide)
Tint the music waveform with the album art color
Orange privacy dot while the microphone is in use
Scroll on the notch to change volume
Monitor
schema.description: "external": the external monitor, or the built-in display when none is connected · "focused" · "all" · or a connector name.

schema.label: Show the clock inside the island
Clock format (Qt, e.g. HH:mm or h:mm AP)
Bubble height (px)
Flash the workspace when switching
